instrument: Oregon Governor's directive pausing state-land data center transactions, September 8, 2026
summary: Directs state agencies to pause unapproved requests for easements, rights-of-way, leases, rentals, land-use permits and sales or transfers of state-owned property for data center projects, in effect until July 1, 2027 or further action by the legislature or Governor; agencies to report status by September 14, 2026.

source.citation: OPB / Oregon Capital Chronicle and The Columbian coverage of the September 8, 2026 Capitol rally and Governor's release; Central Oregon Daily (September 2026) for the July 1, 2027 end date

notes: Reaches state land and state buildings only. Not a statewide moratorium on private land. Refresh against the directive text; check the September 14 agency status report.
confidence_note: Directive text not read. Quoted release language is relayed through coverage.
